display_name: Leverage Shares 2X Long SPCX Daily ETF

about.en: SPCH is the Leverage Shares 2X Long SPCX Daily ETF, a leveraged single-stock exchange-traded fund from Themes ETFs (Leverage Shares US) that seeks twice (2x) the daily performance of Space Exploration Technologies Corp. shares (SPCX) before fees and expenses. Because the leverage resets daily, returns compound and can diverge substantially from 2x the share's performance over periods longer than one day. It is listed on Cboe BZX and is not an investment in SpaceX shares themselves.
